items.claim: The rotate badge was painted on a node that can't rotate, and on a multi-selection holding one, where it can't be grabbed
items.note: The overlay, the rotate ring and the badge's grab region now all ask one predicate, `targetCanRotate`, in `rotationHandleGeometry.ts`.

items.claim: The selection outline dropped `dashOffset`, `miterLimit`, `trim` and markers from the consumer's stroke
items.note: It now passes the whole stroke through and fills in only the paint and width defaults.

items.claim: The shape-outline cache kept an open path's old band after the stroke it inherits changed caps or markers
items.note: The cache key now includes the inherited paint, which `inheritedPaintIn` hands back as the same object while it doesn't change.

items.claim: `boxReader` dropped `scene.shapes`, so selection boxes and handles ignored the scene's own painters
